definitions.explanation: The level of formality, status, or prestige associated with a place, family, organization, or tradition. Implies a long-established reputation and adherence to proper standards.

examples.japanese: {格式|かくしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at a prestigious inn.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{格式|かくしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{参拝者|さんぱいしゃ}→参拝者：21620_sanpaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: This shrine has high prestige and is visited by many worshippers.

examples.japanese: {格式|かくしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|おも}んじる→重んじる：14445_omonjiru⟧あまり、⟦{堅苦|かたくる}しい→堅苦しい：25258_katakurushii⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧になってしまうこと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: By placing too much emphasis on formality, the atmosphere can end up feeling stiff.

notes:
USAGE:
{格式|かくしき} is most commonly used with ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ to describe something of high status or prestige. It applies to temples, shrines, hotels, restaurants, families, and institutions with long histories.
{格式|かくしき} implies tradition and established rank rather than simply being expensive or luxurious. A new hotel may be luxurious but would not typically be described as having {格式|かくしき}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格式|かくしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (of high standing/prestige)
- {格式|かくしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (having prestige)
- {格式|かくしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|おも}んじる→重んじる：14445_omonjiru⟧ (to value formality)
- {格式|かくしき}{張|ば}る (to stand on ceremony)
